plain: Dan Sherman, a former sergeant who says the NSA, the US National Security Agency that handles code-breaking and eavesdropping, hired him to communicate with aliens, tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about his training in the early 1990s. He says he and others rode in an unmarked blue van with blacked-out windows from a facility in Maryland to an underground school, and he names a Captain White as involved. If true, it would mean the government was quietly training people to talk to non-human beings.
